title: Implement "Stop" button for Agent Runs and in Builder
body:
![image.png](https://uploads.linear.app/a47946b5-12cd-4b3d-8822-df04c855879f/2983e383-0173-4c3d-9700-6b1eaf33837d/1737fbd7-a1ee-451d-b54f-0946b460a707?signature=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJwYXRoIjoiL2E0Nzk0NmI1LTEyY2QtNGIzZC04ODIyLWRmMDRjODU1ODc5Zi8yOTgzZTM4My0wMTczLTRjM2QtOTcwMC02YjFlYWYzMzgzN2QvMTczN2ZiZDctYTFlZS00NTFkLWI1NGYtMDk0NmI0NjBhNzA3IiwiaWF0IjoxNzIzMTA4NDg5LCJleHAiOjMzMjkzNjY4NDg5fQ.qDbeWGl4jnIMehtfGsFPqiwU9zdowvrU0gPncBrqipA "=736x")

Don't pay too close attention to my terrible mock-up, but instances with an active status need a way to be stopped.

It would also likely make sense to add this feature to the builder.

- [ ]  **The scope of this should also include on changing the play button on the builder UI to a stop button when the agent is running.**
